$$ \text{Tier 2 Capital in 2008} = \text{Total Capital in 2008} - \text{Tier 1 Capital in 2008} $$  
$$ \text{Tier 2 Capital in 2007} = \text{Total Capital in 2007} - \text{Tier 1 Capital in 2007} $$  
$$ \text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{Tier 2 Capital in 2008}}{\text{Tier 2 Capital in 2007}} $$

The program will follow these steps:

1. Subtract tier 1 capital from total capital for 2008.
2. Subtract tier 1 capital from total capital for 2007.
3. Divide the result from step 1 by the result from step 2.

```plaintext
program: subtract(108.4, 71.0), subtract(121.6, 82.0), divide(#0, #1)
```
